base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y -qq cmake build-essential pkg-config python3-venv git curl
setup_runtime_commands: pip install --quiet numpy>=1.15.0 cython>=0.27 pybind11 setuptools>=24.2.0 wheel build
detected_test_command: python -m pytest src/python/test/test_perslay.py -v && python -m pytest src/python/test/test_diff.py -v
runtime_smoke_command: python -c 'import tensorflow as tf; import numpy; print(f"TensorFlow {tf.__version__}, NumPy {numpy.__version__}")'

prepare_commands: pip install numpy cython pybind11 setuptools wheel build tensorflow pytest scikit-learn
runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: gudhi package must be built with CMake then installed via pip in the venv
runtime_profile.notes: The gudhi package requires CMake build for C++ extensions before pip install. TensorFlow layers tests need the built gudhi package.

notes: Base image python:3.11-slim recommended. git and curl are included in system_packages. The gudhi project uses CMake for C++ core and setuptools/pip for Python packaging. TensorFlow layers are pure Python but require the gudhi package to be built first.
